# The Real Japan

> > Expert-guided tours and comprehensive travel planning resources for exploring Hiroshima, Miyajima, and sustainable Japan experiences with JJ Walsh.

The Real Japan specializes in guided walking tours of UNESCO World Heritage sites in Hiroshima and Miyajima, alongside detailed travel planning guides covering JR Pass usage, language-free navigation, and cultural heritage exploration. Founded by JJ Walsh, the site emphasizes sustainable travel and authentic Japanese experiences.

- Language-Free Travel
